description: Tracker scope uniqueness for factory bindings (#4622, ADR 0197: one binding per resolved tracker scope). A scope is (tracker kind, tracker host trimmed and lowercased, trackerScopeId). Each case gives `values`, the chart's `factory:` block with credentials as existingSecret references, and `forges`, the CURIE_FORGES document charts/curie renders for those values; for a refused case it is the document a chart without the scope check renders. `outcome` is {accepted: true}, {refused: duplicate_scope, bindings: [first, second], scope: {kind, host, trackerScopeId}}, {refused: unknown_tracker, binding, tracker} or {refused: duplicate_name, section: trackers|bindings, name} or {refused: invalid_scope_id, binding, loader: accepted}. A trackerScopeId must be a nonempty string or a whole number below 2^53 in magnitude; the chart and the CLI refuse anything else, while the runtime loader accepts the string an unchecked chart renders for it, so `loader: accepted` records the loader outcome for those cases. A trackerScopeId is compared exactly as rendered: the chart renders a numeric id as its string, and case is significant. Readers, each through its production parser: tools/factory-e2e/tests/test_c4_tracker_scope.py (helm template of charts/curie, curie cluster upgrade, the candidate API image), cli/tests/factory_tracker_scope.rs (curie::factory_intake::check_factory_document) and apps/api/tests/forges/test_tracker_scope_vectors.py (curie_api.forges.loader.load_forges_json). Identifiers are examples only.

cases.name: quickstart_jira_binding
cases.description: The one Bitbucket code host, Jira tracker and Jira binding named jira that quickstart writes. The pin installs it as the baseline release.

cases.name: valid_mixed_repositories
cases.description: One Jira binding listing a GitHub, a GitLab and a Bitbucket Cloud repository under distinct aliases, with a defaultRepo and an allowlist startAuthority.

cases.name: duplicate_scope_through_distinct_tracker_names
cases.description: The released Bitbucket manual-values example applied over the quickstart binding: a second tracker entry for the same Jira site, its host written with different case and surrounding whitespace, and a second binding with the same trackerScopeId.

cases.name: duplicate_scope_same_tracker
cases.description: Two bindings naming the same tracker with the same trackerScopeId.

cases.name: unknown_tracker_reference
cases.description: A binding naming a tracker absent from factory.trackers.

cases.name: distinct_scopes
cases.description: Two bindings on one tracker with different trackerScopeIds, and a third binding with the first trackerScopeId on a Jira tracker of the same kind on another host. Every scope differs, so all are accepted.

cases.name: duplicate_tracker_names
cases.description: Two factory.trackers entries share the name jira, on different hosts.

cases.name: duplicate_binding_names
cases.description: Two factory.bindings entries share the name jira, each with its own trackerScopeId.

cases.name: duplicate_numeric_scope
cases.description: One binding writes trackerScopeId as the number 12345678901 and a second writes the same id as a string; the chart renders both as the string, so they are one scope.

cases.name: duplicate_scope_factory_disabled
cases.description: factory.enabled false does not exempt a duplicate scope: CURIE_FORGES renders from the lists either way and the API loads it at boot.

cases.name: case_distinct_scope_ids
cases.description: trackerScopeIds ABC and abc on one tracker are distinct scopes: the runtime compares them exactly, without case folding.

cases.name: same_scope_id_different_tracker_kinds
cases.description: A jira_cloud tracker and a gitlab tracker on the same host, each bound with trackerScopeId 4242: the tracker kind is part of the scope, so they are distinct.

cases.name: scope_id_null
cases.description: The quickstart binding with trackerScopeId null. The chart and the CLI refuse it before rollout; a chart without the check renders it as "<nil>", which the runtime loader accepts as a string.

cases.name: scope_id_list
cases.description: The quickstart binding with trackerScopeId the list [1, 2]. The chart and the CLI refuse it before rollout; a chart without the check renders it as "[1 2]", which the runtime loader accepts as a string.

cases.name: scope_id_out_of_range
cases.description: The quickstart binding with trackerScopeId 1e20, a number past 2^53. The chart and the CLI refuse it before rollout; a chart without the check renders it as "-9223372036854775808" on amd64, which the runtime loader accepts as a string.
